name: Esteemed Elders' Totems Use No Villager Records
description: In the stock game every Esteemed Elder's totem statue takes one of the village's 256 villager records for good, so in a big village the statues crowd out babies waiting to be born. With this patch the totems are kept apart, in a file beside each save ('Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <n>\Data\Elder Totems\ElderTotems.dat'), and take no villager record: when a village loads, every totem in it moves into that file and its record is free for a villager. The totems look, sort, show their "<name>`s totem" label and can be dragged and placed exactly as before, on the village and on the Map. There is no longer a limit of 50 Esteemed Elders. **The stock game never reads ElderTotems.dat: before removing this patch, use Repair Saves & Logs > "Put Totems Back Into the Save" (with the game closed), or the village shows no totems (nothing else changes).** Repair Saves & Logs can also move totems out with the game closed ("Move Totems Out of the Save"), change an elder's totem colour, and give Esteemed Elders who have none their totem. **Unverified in play: this has not been tested in the running game yet.** **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: A totem statue record in a loaded village (Is Totem +0x558 set and health 0 or less) is moved into ElderTotems.dat and its record freed; a villager with the mark but health above 0 is never moved.
A new Esteemed Elder's totem (0x44D190) is kept in ElderTotems.dat with everything the game copies onto it; the elder is marked and counted by the game's own pass, as before.
No limit of 50 totems: the elder pass's two checks (0x44D4D1, 0x44D54C) never wait while the store works; the full-village guard's wait no longer applies to totems, which need no record.

Store totems are drawn with the game's own calls in the game's own y order, on the village and on the Map; a click picks one in front of the villager the game found; the name panel shows "<name>`s totem"; dragging, the dust, the totem puzzle spot (terrain 0x42), the nudge off unfit ground and the stored home x/y are as the game does them for a totem record.
ElderTotems.dat is written before each save of the slot and read after each load; one bound to another village is moved aside, never used or overwritten.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion verifies every site's stock bytes and installs all of them or none; a different build of the game installs nothing.
The .ldw save stays the stock game's own format: it simply holds no totem records.
If ElderTotems.dat exists but cannot be opened, that session runs as the stock game (nothing is moved, and the game's own 50-totem limit stands).
Village Statistics, the logs and the family tree never counted totems as villagers and still do not.
evidence_status: static exact-build verification of every site and emulator tests of each hook against the stock executable; runtime/player confirmation pending

runtime_detours.routine: the slot load (thiscall manager, slot): after a village loads, ElderTotems.dat is read and every totem statue record (Is Totem +0x558 set, health 0 or less) is moved into the store and its record freed as the burial frees one (0x46503B)
the slot save (thiscall manager, slot): before a village slot is written, the store is written to ElderTotems.dat (a temporary file, then a move); a save that could not write it is refused
the world reset (new tribe, Start Over, the startup's seeding): the store is emptied
the Esteemed Elder's totem maker: the statue goes into the store, never into a record
the elder pass's first 'fewer than 50 totems' check: no limit while the store works
the elder pass's second 'fewer than 50 totems' check (after the full-village guard's count): no limit while the store works
the village draw loop's start: store totems drawn in the game's y order among the records
the village draw loop's end: the rest, and a totem being dragged last
the Map's end: store totems drawn as the Map draws a totem
the click's hit test (0x44D580): a store totem in front of the record found is picked
after the hit test: a picked store totem ends the click (no camera drag, no other action)
the village mouse handler: a picked store totem is dragged and placed as a totem record is
the name panel with no record selected: "<name>`s totem" for a picked store totem
